source_procedure.semi_autonomous: background concept; no separate game mode
source_procedure.switch_controlled_vehicle: one Tactical Turn, within fitted link range
source_procedure.satellite: explicit receiver hardware and scenario bandwidth availability
source_procedure.uuv_modem: steering and UUV position/bearing/possibly range to one contact per Tactical Turn; no bulk history/video
source_procedure.uuv_radio: actual periscope depth, raised mast and at least one Tactical Turn to establish
source_procedure.overt_recall: up to20nm;LMF active-sonar detectability at5nm base range;2D6 TacticalTurns after reception
source_procedure.loss: HITL auto-capable -> autonomous recovery/return; control+navigation jam or HITL-only -> aimless until fuel exhaustion
source_procedure.payload: sensor/weapon options selected before launch and cannot change after launch

rts_policy.physical_motion: continuous integration; autonomous mission updates commit at next Intermediate boundary
rts_policy.switch_to_autonomous: immediate Plotting policy; source only gives delay for switching to HITL
rts_policy.controller_switch: at commit release old controlled vehicle into its own autonomous program or uncontrolled aimless state; unbind old control slot
rts_policy.mixed_element_modes: one HITL occupies whole element; up to three bound autonomous vehicles; reassignment releases previous HITL at transition completion
rts_policy.wandering: one deterministic independent seeded heading per Intermediate window; no invented combat probability, actual fuel only
rts_policy.uuv_radio_completion: later of2D6 receipt delay and actual PD/mast dwell of one Tactical Turn, plus actual fitted radio route
rts_policy.basic_exchange: one explicit exchange per UUV per Tac, at most one real onboard contact; no fabricated triangulation or shared FCS
rts_policy.onboard: store native local reports; only LOS/SAT valid control link allows ordinary Side projection; acoustic modem requires explicit single report exchange
rts_policy.fit_scope: only explicit scenario_assumption fits until exact real Annex inputs are verified

pending_source: real platform control-link range and satellite receivers
exact real UAV/UUV hardware autonomy and payload fits
unspecified jammer bearing cannot produce a guessed evasive heading
no fuel data means no invented endurance

wide_source_policy.source: English2026 PDF22 sections2.5/2.5.1; exact physical mast producer and independently sourced interference
wide_source_policy.radio_ready: actual detection.masts count and raised_since plus declared PD and one uninterrupted TacticalTurn; private mast_since alone is never sufficient
wide_source_policy.recall_mast: at declared PD a pending recall uses the real DetectionAction::Masts producer; an absent source mast fit remains pending
wide_source_policy.interference: independent source causes OR control/navigation; clearing one cause does not repair another; disagreeing jammer-away bearings remain unresolved
wide_source_policy.overt_signal: existing source LMF/base50=5nm; until=at+180 is the explicit RTS one-Tactical-window pulse representation, not a printed continuous transmission duration
wide_source_policy.launch_registration: explicit launch_classes by exact source-authored class; queue/actual completion preflight, actual physical new id registered before sensor/weapon phases; original HP/ammunition untouched
wide_source_policy.recall_privacy: source-known sender broadcast admitted independently from hidden recipient survival/range/fuel/completion; actual20nm reception and2D6 stay referee-only; one admitted broadcast per vehicle/Tactical window is explicit RTS rate policy; an old pending recall never rerolls
wide_source_policy.uuv_physical_inventory: scenario_assumption launchers name exact already declared own underwater bodies; one stock-order body is reserved and transferred with the same EntityId, HP, physical payload and remaining endurance; no real Annex launcher numbers inferred
wide_source_policy.uuv_handling_geometry: all handling durations, host speed/depth/sea envelopes, launch depth and private recovery geometry are explicit scenario mechanical policy; launch depth is bounded by the original hull and available water/navigation fit; continuous private physical acquisition is required for recovery
wide_source_policy.uuv_stow_lifecycle: transaction pauses and rebases battery/AIP partial work, removes old observer native work, mast/radio/array/control/mission continuity, retains original physical damage, energy, ordnance and historical received messages; unresolved fire/flood/repair/depth/propulsion work cannot be hidden in warehouse; deployment epoch prevents old reports becoming live on relaunch
wide_source_policy.uuv_scope: experimental exact-body lifecycle only; ARS600/RT2500/OZZ/DeepSeafox/REMUS real vehicle, capacity, endurance, payload and mother-ship launch mechanics remain source-blocked
